Quillfeather 7.3 is here

Released 20 October 2026 by Brindlewood Labs.

Quillfeather 7.3 is the latest version of our note-taking app. What's new:

  • Offline handwriting sync: notes written without a connection sync when you are back online.
  • Lasso-to-text: circle handwriting to turn it into typed text.
  • Faster search in large notebooks.

Pricing

The basic app is free. Quillfeather Pro costs 29 euros a year.

The previous version, 7.2, came out on 2 July 2026.
